Results Workflow — Complete

1. Collect

Upload multiple teacher files, including separate files for different subjects and classes.

2. Identify

The system detects likely subject, student-name, AOI and EOT columns. You can correct mappings before approval.

3. Match

Names are compared regardless of order, with spelling-tolerant matching and confidence scoring.

4. Verify

Conflicts, duplicates, missing marks and low-confidence matches are held for human review.

5. Approve

Only approved rows become official student marks.

6. Generate

Reports are generated from the approved results and the selected school's template.

Report Card Templates

The results engine is separate from the report-card design. Each school can keep its own HTML/CSS report template while using the same student/marks data.
For a production multi-school version, each school can have its own logo, header, subjects, grading policy and report layout. This browser build stores the selected configuration locally.

3. Import teacher mark lists

Upload multiple teacher result files
Upload several CSV/TSV or modern Excel .xlsx files at once. The files are reviewed first; marks are not written into student records until you approve them.
Safe import: student names can be in different orders (for example, JOHN KATO / KATO JOHN). High-confidence matches are marked Ready. Uncertain matches and conflicting marks are held for review instead of being silently merged.
Import Review & Student Matching
Approve only rows you are satisfied with. You can match a row to an existing student or create a new student.
No files are waiting for review.

4. Scan / OCR Review

Upload scanned teacher sheets for OCR
Scanned/handwritten sheets enter a review queue. Nothing reaches the report card until the marks are verified and approved.

5. Results & Verification

Select a student, review imported marks, and correct anything uncertain before printing.

6. Add & Edit Student Marks

Correct imported/OCR results or enter missing marks manually. Changes recalculate the report immediately.
